headline: Barry Callebaut Flavourcode; RFINE and Planet A Foods launch cocoa-powder replacers
summary: Barry Callebaut launched Flavourcode, a controlled cocoa-fermentation flavour platform, while reporting falling profits; Belcolade should assess the gap in fermentation-driven flavour and watch for aggressive pricing.

Cocoa-saving launches multiplied: RFINE's KAFFIKA (upcycled coffee grounds, up to 60% cocoa powder replacement) and Planet A Foods' Cocoa Booster join new fibre-claim cocoa alternatives, and pladis is scouting fermentation and cocoa-alternative start-ups, making both partnership targets and competitors for Belcolade.
Roquette and Palsgaard pushed into gluten-free bakery texture and cake emulsifiers, so Puratos gluten-free mixes and cake improvers need benchmarking.

Sourdough keeps spreading (Pepperidge Farm cookies, Toufayan pita, Papa Johns pizza), backed by new research on sourdough cryoprotection and temperature control, an opening for Sapore in sweet goods, flatbreads and foodservice.

US policy pressure is building on ultra-processed food definitions and a proposed federal synthetic-dye ban, so keep clean-label and natural-colour reformulations ready for bakery, patisserie and chocolate customers.

items.title: Atlantic Canada’s RFINE Launches KAFFIKA®, a Gluten-Free Cocoa Extender from Brewed Coffee Grounds That Replaces up to 60% of Cocoa Powder
items.summary: Atlantic Canada start-up RFINE launched KAFFIKA, a gluten-free cocoa extender made from upcycled brewed coffee grounds that it says replaces up to 60% of cocoa powder.
items.why: A North American upcycled cocoa-extender start-up is a direct competitor or partnership target for Belcolade cocoa-saving solutions; consider testing it in chocolate fillings and cakes.

items.title: Can science keep up with chocolate’s ambitions?
items.summary: A feature on how fermentation, cocoa alternatives and cultured cacao are giving bakery and snack makers new options for chocolate flavour, formulation and supply.
items.why: An overview of the cocoa-alternative and controlled-fermentation field Belcolade competes in; check which start-ups and technologies are named as potential partners.

items.title: Planet A Foods tackles cocoa supply instability and fibre demand with new Cocoa Booster solution
items.summary: Planet A Foods launched Cocoa Booster, a cocoa-powder replacer aimed at cocoa supply instability and fibre demand.
items.why: Cocoa-free chocolate leader Planet A Foods (ChoViva) moving into cocoa powder replacement competes directly with Belcolade cocoa-saving products; evaluate or partner.

items.title: pladis Opens Second Accelerator Call With Focus on Fermentation and Cocoa Alternatives
items.summary: pladis opened a second accelerator call seeking start-ups in fermentation and cocoa alternatives.
items.why: A major biscuit maker scouting cocoa alternatives is both a customer opportunity and a signal of which start-ups will be courted; Belcolade should engage.

items.title: Pro Tip: Understanding that shelf life is more than mold control

items.title: Barry Callebaut plots comeback after profits tumble

items.why: The main Belcolade competitor is under pressure and doubling down on partnerships; watch for pricing moves and customer offers.

items.title: Влияние отечественных ферментных препаратов липолитического действия на качество хлебобулочных изделий
items.summary: Russian study of domestically produced lipolytic enzyme preparations of varying activity and their effect on dough rheology and bread quality in a sugar- and fat-free recipe.
items.why: Lipase as a fat-replacing dough improver is core to Puratos S500 enzyme improvers; a reference for benchmarking lipase dosing.

items.title: Исследование биотехнологических свойств чистых культур дрожжей для хлебопекарной промышленности

items.why: Defined starter consortia are directly relevant to Sapore sourdough and Puratos's controlled fermentation work.

items.summary: Trinidad study characterising natural variation in cocoa butter traits across cacao genetic resources, with implications for breeding.
items.why: Cocoa butter diversity in breeding material is relevant to Belcolade origin sourcing and long-term cocoa butter functionality.

items.title: Designing Foods with Maize, Sorghum and Millet Bran: Processing–Inclusion–Matrix Relationships and Product Performance
